t: Told about a sūrah before leaving the mosque
a: {الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ} هِيَ السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي وَالْقُرْآنُ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُهُ
m: I will teach you the greatest sūrah in the Qur'an before you leave the mosque. Then as he was about to go out, he said: it is all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds, the seven oft-repeated and the great Qur'an that I was given.
